name: Campingpark Oberammergau
beschreibung: Campingpark Oberammergau is set amidst stunning alpine scenery near the Tyrolean border. The picturesque surrounding landscape provides ideal conditions for leisurely strolls as well as demanding alpine mountain tours. The campsite itself impresses with modern infrastructure, featuring pristine sanitary facilities and clearly designated pitches for motorhomes and tents. Additional amenities include a well-stocked convenience store and an inviting inn serving delicious regional delicacies. Its tranquil and welcoming family atmosphere makes the camping park a favourite destination for nature lovers and recreation seekers who appreciate first-class pitches with direct access to the mountains.
